$Comment: The skeleton every Harvest Feast achievement inherits through Parent. It is never earned.
Occurrence ties an achievement to the Harvest_Feast calendar event: the library keeps one copy a
year, named <id>_<year>, that counts only while that year's feast runs and stays a feat for whoever
earned it. Listing files every one under the Seasons category, in the Harvest_Feast subcategory,
which is where the Almanac and The Full Table look for them. TextArgs puts the year into each title.
A child takes its words from the keys its id spells (achievement.<id>.title and .desc); a child that
writes its own Listing or TextArgs keeps these leaves and adds its own.
This file sits outside the _Harvest_Feast folder on purpose: its file name already spells its id, so
Parent names it the same way in the game and in the build's own content check.
